question: How should a doubt-free practitioner behave among those dependent on scripture and conduct?
premises: A practitioner may be inwardly free from doubt.
Others remain dependent on scripture and ritual conduct.
Mixing levels of practice can cause confusion.
inference: Even a doubt-free practitioner should avoid creating confusion when among those bound to scriptural conduct.
uncertainties: The precise sense of 'saṃvṛti' here may range from discretion to concealment.
plain_english: Therefore, if one is free from doubt, one should remain discreet and avoid causing confusion when among those who depend on scripture and ritual conduct.
